label: late original phase / <DEL> step, gated by first token (esp. q)
explanation: Fires almost exclusively in the second half of the original-token phase (t>=3, peaking t=4-8) and at the <DEL> step (30% of delimiter steps, 33% of mass); essentially silent at t<2 and in the copy phase except a weak echo on the first copy step. Position alone gives recall 0.96 / mass 0.97 for t>=3 but precision only 0.21: whether it fires depends on sequence content, most strongly the first original token (first_tok q: 31% rate, 4.1x lift; then 0, c, w, y, 2). Top activations (~0.8-1.0 of max) are sequences starting with q (often q q) with j/v/h/m among recent inputs; activation ramps up over the original phase toward <DEL>. Prefers first occurrences of tokens (in_first). The content dependence looks distributed (many tokens contribute), so the first-token predicate reaches only F1 ~0.56.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the first original token (most: q, 0, c, w, y, 2; least: p, j, s, r) and the third original token (most: j, 3, v, k, e, h; least: 0, a, l, d); timing cues that raise it most: t=6, t=4, t=5.
